description.en: A noncalcified algal thallus has several nested orders of lateral branching.
description.zh: 非钙化藻体具有多级嵌套侧分枝。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Eocladus, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Eocladus 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Hierarchical feathery subdivisions differ from Chaetocladus's simple radial brush and Bosworthia's broad ribbons.
distinctness.zh: 分级羽状细分区别于Chaetocladus简单放射刷和Bosworthia宽带枝。

modeling_brief.en: Use distinct thickness steps between branch orders and a flattened specimen layout; simplify terminal count only.
modeling_brief.zh: 在分枝级间使用明确粗细阶差，并采用扁平标本布局；仅简化末枝数量。

uncertainty: Specimen plates must settle missing tips and out-of-plane branching before production.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Complex noncalcified macroalgae from the Silurian of Cornwallis Island
sources.supports: Eocladus complex branching orders and Silurian occurrence.
